Long Input Pseudorandom Function-like States. The input size needs to be omega(log(n)) qubits. All edges out of this node hold with output length at least the input length (as obtained from a PRU).
Ananth, Qian and Yuen. Cryptography from Pseudorandom Quantum States. Crypto'22.

Quantum-Accessible Long Input Pseudorandom Function-like States: input omega(log(n)) qubits, pure outputs of length at least the input length, adaptively secure against quantum (superposition) queries ([AGQY22](https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-031-22318-1_9) Def. 4.3, [BCJZ26](https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1206) Def. 18).

Batra, Chen, Jain and Zhang. Scalable, quantum-accessible, and adaptive pseudorandom quantum state and pseudorandom function-like quantum state generators. CRYPTO'26. Thm 7: scalable (every output length, including c*log(n)), adaptive, quantum-accessible PRFS with pure outputs. Improves [AGQY22](https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-031-22318-1_9) Lemma 5.10 (classical queries only) and Thm 5.12 (super-logarithmic output only), and [AQY22](https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-031-15802-5_8) (selective security, classical queries). Stated for post-quantum OWF; extends to QOWF since the reduction is fully black-box, see [KQT25](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.02554).
Long Input Pseudorandom Function-like States with Proofs of Destruction
Behera, Brakerski, Sattath and Shmueli. Pseudorandomness with Proof of Destruction and Applications. IACR eprint, 2023.

Short Output Pseudorandom States. The output state needs to have c*log(n) qubits for some large enough c, for example a scalable PRS [BS20b](https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-030-56880-1_15) instantiated at logarithmic output length.
Brakerski and Shmueli. Scalable Pseudorandom Quantum States. CRYPTO'20.

Short Output Pseudorandom Function-Like States. The output state needs to have c*log(n) qubits for some large enough c; any input length; pure outputs; adaptively secure against quantum (superposition) queries, as in [BCJZ26](https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1206) Def. 18. Obtained by instantiating a scalable PRFS at logarithmic output length.

Batra, Chen, Jain and Zhang. Scalable, quantum-accessible, and adaptive pseudorandom quantum state and pseudorandom function-like quantum state generators. CRYPTO'26. Thm 7: scalable (every output length, including c*log(n)), adaptive, quantum-accessible PRFS with pure outputs. Improves [AGQY22](https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-031-22318-1_9) Lemma 5.10 (classical queries only) and Thm 5.12 (super-logarithmic output only), and [AQY22](https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-031-15802-5_8) (selective security, classical queries). Stated for post-quantum OWF; extends to QOWF since the reduction is fully black-box, see [KQT25](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.02554).
